description: Exercise #57 meeting after 45 s without radio. No fire or people distract the search. A damaged radio has a 3 m physical range, allowing initial contact at the gate then losing it as robots separate. Evidence is rendezvous with out_of_contact_s at least 45 and unshared_cells at least 1500. A 40 s recording cannot exercise this unchanged rule; 90 s leaves time to return and exchange maps.
duration_s_reason: Test observation window; also the existing recorder operating deadline. Meeting and heat re-entry require their full physical waiting periods.

fire.head_start_s_reason: Fire age when robots reach the launch pads. Zero for delayed ignition, 6 s to develop a local flame, 60 s for a heated compartment.
fire.config_file_reason: World-only fuel ignition experiment. Heat and smoke load the same file.

radio.range_m_reason: World radio damage experiment: reduced transmitter range. No contact timestamps or robot meeting thresholds change.
